chose: In waiting_first the wanted term comes after tried: the excused note, then fewest attempts, then notes something waits on with the most waited-on first, then oldest. Among notes tried as often, the most-wanted is the serialized blocker and goes first.
options: wanted after tried, so TR1 holds whole
wanted before tried, so a wanted note that keeps failing goes first on every retry
gray: TR1 (C895) says a note that keeps failing never holds the queue; wanted ahead of tried would break it for every wanted note, so an essay's take that keeps running to its deadline waits behind fresher notes on its retries.
undo: Move the wanted term ahead of tried in waiting_first, which first needs TR1 amended.
